title: BloodBone Sword
description: It adds a sword which has a dash ablity and its pretty cool and also has a mace smash ablity!~
body:
🩸 Bloodbone Sword 🦴

Unleash the power of cursed bone and blood.

The Bloodbone Sword is no ordinary weapon—it grants its wielder unmatched mobility and devastating strength. Instantly dash forward to close gaps, chase enemies, or escape danger in style. But that’s not all…

Charge up its Mace Smash Ability to unleash a massive, ground-shaking slam that crushes everything in your path. Perfect for crowd control, clutch fights, or just asserting dominance.

⚔️ Abilities:

Dash Strike – Rapidly lunge forward with deadly precision
Bonebreaker Smash – A powerful AoE slam inspired by mace combat

💀 Forged from cursed remains. Feared by all.
